title: tcp: Optimize OOO reassembly a bit
description:
Don't check for an updated contiguous length so often, it can
be linear on long reassemblies.

Also use the first gap to speed things up when we have it.

commits_data.title: tcp: Optimize contiguous check with first gap
commits_data.message:
tcp: Optimize contiguous check with first gap

As we now store a pointer to the first gap of a reassembly
(commit 5853886d50f2294d4643871878c921a69b8408d5 ), we can
speed this up a bit.
